title: Palatine Hill Ancient Roman Ruins in Rome, 1960s B&W Travel Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th-century horizontal black-and-white snapshot showing the imposing ancient Roman brick substructures and imperial palaces on the Palatine Hill as viewed from the area of the Circus Maximus (Via dei Cerchi / Via del Circo Massimo) in Rome, Italy. The foreground features a paved roadway, simple timber railing fences, and a modern single-story brick structure nestled at the base of the historical ruins under a clear sky.
